self_assessment.weakest_area: Featured/recent split + curator ranking is not yet live-tested (site has 0 published collections). The /api/collections endpoint returns empty; the sort code has not exercised real data. Post-auth intent plugin also has not been through a full OAuth round-trip.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Ranking for 'featured' uses curator labels (verified-maintainer > prolific > early-curator) + collectionCount as a proxy, since follower-count (per the ranking memory) is not available server-side via the curators index. Memory says rank by curator follower graph, but that data lives in atproto and is not currently indexed server-side.

known_limitations: Preamble input is plain textarea (paragraph split on double newline for rendering). Full markdown rendering is not implemented; headings/lists/links render as plain text. If richer formatting is needed later, swap in a markdown renderer.

AT Protocol lexicon schema file (./lexicons/dev.skilld.collection.json) does not exist in this repo — only the TS validator was updated. If an external lexicon spec is published elsewhere, it needs the preamble field added too.
The featured ranking relies on curator.labels being populated; a curator with no labels + many collections may rank below a labelled curator with fewer. Revisit once curator-follower data is indexed.
/collections/new is in the sitemap. It sets robots=noindex so crawlers will skip indexing, but a dedicated sitemap exclusion could be cleaner.
next_steps: Publish a real collection with a preamble to validate the full SEO rendering (meta description, preamble block, card excerpt).
Consider topic/stack landing pages (/collections/stacks/{stack}) for additional SEO capture — already marked out-of-scope in this contract.
Add curator follower counts to the server-side index so featured ranking can honour the memoryed model.
